policies.title: Saint Lucian ordinary passports: Grenada visitor visa waiver
policies.summary: Grenada's active Embassy-linked nationality schedule lists Saint Lucia as not requiring a visa.
conditions: Applies to a Saint Lucian ordinary passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
The active Embassy schedule was updated April 2024 and should be rechecked if Grenada publishes a replacement.
Work, study, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Saint Lucian ordinary passports: Iceland visitor visa waiver
policies.summary: Iceland's current visa regulation lists Saint Lucia in Annex 9's nationalities exempt from a visa on arrival.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Saint Lucian passport holder travelling for a short visit under the regulation's visa-exemption schedule.
Residence, work, special documents, entry conditions and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Saint Lucian ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's official nationality table says Saint Lucian visitors can obtain a visa on arrival.
conditions: Applies to a Saint Lucian ordinary passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Jordan's page instructs non-Jordanian visitors to register through Gateway2Jordan before departure and present the resulting QR code.
Restricted crossings, non-visitor purposes and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Saint Lucian ordinary passports: Panama visitor visa waiver
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy nationality schedule lists Saint Lucia in its No Visa Required cohort.
conditions: Applies to a Saint Lucian ordinary passport holder travelling as a short visitor for up to three months.
Work, residence, transit, special documents and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Saint Lucian ordinary passports: Türkiye electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Türkiye's Foreign Ministry expressly makes ordinary Saint Lucian passports eligible for a 90-day multiple-entry eVisa, delivered electronically before travel.
conditions: Applies to a Saint Lucian ordinary passport holder travelling for tourism or trade; the eVisa portal does not cover work or residence.
Türkiye's official eVisa portal requires application information and payment before it emails the download link.
The Foreign Ministry also describes an advance-mission route; final admission remains outside scope.

application.label: Türkiye eVisa application
steps: Start an application using the ordinary Saint Lucian passport details and travel dates.
Enter the required information and pay electronically by an accepted card.
Download the eVisa from the emailed link before travel and retain a copy for arrival.

conflicts.explanation: Türkiye's current Foreign Ministry guidance directs ordinary Saint Lucian passport holders to obtain an eVisa electronically or an advance visa from a mission; it does not describe an arrival-issued route.
